why_best: Synchronizing visual emphasis directly with sonic peaks creates an irresistible focal point that guarantees critical marketing claims land with maximum precision.
why_bad: Allowing the visual response to linger or drift continuously would destroy the video's rhythmic drive and soften the sharp punch of the audio design.
trap: A near-miss will let the visual echo hang around a fraction of a second too long, muddying the frame and ruining the crisp tightness of the audio cue.
